def peanoAdd7513 (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat

theorem peanoAdd7513_add (f : Nat → Nat) (a b x : Nat) : peanoAdd7513 f (a + b) x = peanoAdd7513 f b (peanoAdd7513 f a x) :=
A: by
  induction a generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [peanoAdd7513]

    rw [show k + 1 + b = (k + b) + 1 by omega]

  | succ k ih => simp [plus3270, ih]
theorem plus3270_comm (n m : Nat) : plus3270 n m = plus3270 m n :=

  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [plus3270, plus3270_zero_right]
